result.instructions: Tools for Sakari, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which conversations in my Sakari inbox have unread messages?"; "How many text messages did we send this week and what is my balance?"; "Find the contact with mobile ending 4421 and show our last messages.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sakari data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sakari_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sakari_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sakari_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. sakari_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sakari_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Sakari account these credentials belong to: name, plan, balance, default country, business info and options. API credentials are never returned. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}.

tools.name: sakari_get_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: Prepaid balance, default country, remaining segments and the price per segment. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/balance.

tools.name: sakari_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (partial matches on name, mobile or email; filter by tag). GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/contacts.

first_name.description: Filter by first name or part of it.

last_name.description: Filter by last name or part of it.

mobile.description: Filter by mobile number or part of it.

email.description: Filter by email or part of it.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sakari_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id: name, mobile (with validity and line type), email, lists, attributes, opt-in and blocked state. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: sakari_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact. If a contact with the same mobile number exists, merge_strategy decides what happens (append, core or remove, per Sakari). A contact is not opted in to messages by this call. POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/contacts.

mobile.description: Mobile number in international format, e.g. +13471234567.

country.description: 2-letter country of the number (default: the account's default country).

merge_strategy.description: How an existing contact with the same mobile is treated.

tools.name: sakari_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's name, email or mobile. Sakari's update replaces the contact, so this reads the current contact first and sends it back whole (lists, opt-in, blocked, attributes) with only your changes applied. PUT /v1/accounts/{accountId}/contacts/{contactId}.

mobile.description: New mobile number in international format.

tools.name: sakari_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List messages (sent and received) with status, segments, price and timestamps; filter by contact or conversation. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/messages.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sakari_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: One message by id: text, direction, status, segments, price, error. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/messages/{messageId}.

tools.name: sakari_send_message
tools.title: Send text message
tools.description: WRITE: SEND REAL TEXT MESSAGES that cost account balance and cannot be recalled. Recipients: phone numbers (international format), existing contact ids, or conversation ids (max 100 in total). Only text people who opted in; Sakari enforces TCPA/CTIA rules and the sender is responsible. Confirm the recipients and the text with the user first. Placeholders like {{firstName}} are filled per contact. POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/messages.

to_numbers.description: Recipient phone numbers in international format.

conversation_ids.description: Existing conversation ids to reply into.

confirm_send.description: Must be true: you confirm the user approved these recipients and this text, and that the texts go out now.

tools.name: sakari_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations (the inbox): contact, last message, unread count, open or closed. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/conversations.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sakari_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: One conversation by id. Use sakari_list_messages with conversation_id for its messages. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/conversations/{conversationId}.

tools.name: sakari_close_conversation
tools.title: Close conversation
tools.description: WRITE: mark a conversation closed in the Sakari inbox (a new inbound message reopens it). PUT /v1/accounts/{accountId}/conversations/{conversationId}/close.

tools.name: sakari_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List reusable message templates. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/templates.

name.description: Filter by name or part of it.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sakari_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: One message template by id. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/templates/{templateId}.

tools.name: sakari_create_template
tools.title: Create template
tools.description: WRITE: create a reusable SMS template (does not send anything). POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/templates.

text.description: Template text; may contain placeholders such as {{firstName}}.

tools.name: sakari_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List message campaigns with schedule, template, status and reporting. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/campaigns.

name.description: Filter by name or part of it.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sakari_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: One campaign by id. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: sakari_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: Call history (voice) with direction, status, duration and contact; filter by contact, conversation, direction, status or date range. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/calls.

from.description: Start of the date range (ISO 8601 date-time).

to.description: End of the date range (ISO 8601 date-time).

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sakari_get_call
tools.title: Get call
tools.description: One call history record by id. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/calls/{callId}.

tools.name: sakari_list_links
tools.title: List tracked links
tools.description: Shortened tracked links with destination, short URL and click stats. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/links.

tools.name: sakari_list_forms
tools.title: List lead forms
tools.description: Lead capture forms with active state, impressions and conversions. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/forms.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sakari_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: Active webhook subscriptions (message event notifications). GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/webhooks.

tools.name: sakari_list_autoresponders
tools.title: List autoresponders
tools.description: Autoresponders (automatic replies) configured on the account. GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/autoresponders.
